verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no product-native way to set up background automations that run on their own, such as scheduled jobs, triggers, or recurring tasks. Framer's agents work interactively from user prompts, and external agents act only when a user drives them from their own tools. The Server API's "automate publishing" is a developer building block that someone would have to build automation on top of, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
